purpose: Evaluate fixed pattern-recognition candidates on blind_protocol_v1 without fitting, tuning, threshold selection, modality selection, or algorithm selection on the blind cohort.

blind_protocol.allocation_visibility_during_inference: Only public-cohort.json is allowed. allocation.sealed.json, phase timelines, evaluation-reference tables, and run packages are forbidden until predictions are committed.

development_provenance.interpretation: All three previous runs and every reported result are development evidence only. None is a confirmatory test after this freeze.

known_normal_reference.source: First eighteen distinct post-warmup starts for each blind run and service. The protocol guarantees that this interval precedes the earliest fault.

representation.base_transform: Apply log1p to non-negative magnitudes listed in compare_algorithms.LOG1P_FEATURES before local normalization.
representation.reference_center: Per-run and service median over the eighteen reference starts.
representation.reference_scale: Per-run and service IQR; fall back to reference standard deviation and then 1.0.
representation.imputation: Use the local reference median; use 0 only when the feature is absent throughout that local reference.
representation.blind_inference_rule: Compute every representation chronologically without condition labels. Do not create discontinuities at unknown phase boundaries.

sequence_rule.history_source: Non-reference starts only; the eighteen reference starts are not sequence inputs.
sequence_rule.continuity: Never cross run, service, or a gap other than ten seconds.
sequence_rule.evaluation_filter_after_reveal: A common endpoint is primary-eligible only when its complete twelve-step history belongs to one pure evaluation condition. Scores are still produced blindly for every continuous eligible endpoint.

training_and_calibration.model_fit_source: The original development train run fixed in partition_manifest_v1.
training_and_calibration.hyperparameter_and_threshold_source: The original development validation run. Values are copied below and may not be recomputed.
training_and_calibration.previous_test_policy: The old test run remains development evidence and is not used to refit, recalibrate, or choose among the frozen variants.
training_and_calibration.score_calibration: Empirical percentile by service fitted on non-reference train-normal scores only.

candidate_matrix.fit_population: Train-normal non-reference service-windows as negatives and affected-service pure-fault train windows as positives; other fault services excluded; equal total class weight.
Train-normal non-reference service-windows as negatives and affected-service pure-fault train windows as positives; other fault services excluded; equal total class weight.
Non-reference pure-normal sequences from the original development train run only.

architecture.decoder: latent vector repeated for twelve steps, single-layer LSTM and linear projection

candidate_matrix.input_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on all time steps of development train-normal sequences only.
candidate_matrix.raw_score: mean squared standardized reconstruction error over all steps and features

candidate_matrix.fit_population: Non-reference pure-normal sequences from the original development train run only.

architecture.decoder: latent vector repeated for twelve steps, single-layer LSTM and linear projection

candidate_matrix.input_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on all time steps of development train-normal sequences only.
candidate_matrix.raw_score: mean squared standardized reconstruction error over all steps and features

blind_prediction_contract.score_generation: Generate scores for all ten frozen model_id values before opening allocation-revealed.json.

predictions_manifest.model_artifacts: One SHA-256 entry for each fitted model or deterministic rule specification.
predictions_manifest.score_files: SHA-256, row count, run codes, and model IDs for every score file delivered for reveal.

evaluation_plan.label_join_time: Only after predictions-commitment.json exists and the blind allocation is revealed.
evaluation_plan.primary_task: System condition detection on the common sequence-eligible population.
evaluation_plan.system_aggregation: Maximum calibrated service score for each run_code, model_id, and window_start.
evaluation_plan.primary_metric: Pooled average precision over pure normal and pure fault common endpoints, with the empirical positive prevalence reported beside it.
evaluation_plan.common_population: Endpoints available to every tabular and temporal candidate after the eighteen-start reference and twelve-step history requirements. After reveal, require the complete source window and complete twelve-step history to belong to one pure normal or fault condition.
evaluation_plan.native_population_reporting: Tabular and temporal native populations may be reported secondarily but may not replace the common-population comparison.

mandatory_control_gate.population: All common endpoints in the three no-fault control runs.
mandatory_control_gate.alert_episode: Merge positive system points separated by less than thirty seconds into one episode.
mandatory_control_gate.interpretation: A candidate that exceeds the gate is not operationally admissible even if its average precision is high.

secondary_tasks.affected_service_detection: Average precision for affected-service fault windows against normal service-windows on the common population; other services during fault are excluded from this binary task.
secondary_tasks.localization: MRR, mean rank, Hit@1 and Hit@3 for the affected component during pure fault common endpoints; tied scores use the midpoint rank.
secondary_tasks.detection_delay: Seconds from the first common endpoint at or after fault onset to the first positive system alert, capped at the fault duration for a miss.
secondary_tasks.temporal_decoupling: Report every metric separately for early, middle and late fault cells and for each repetition. A response fixed to run age rather than fault onset is evidence of temporal confounding.
secondary_tasks.multimodal_increment: Within each family, report paired trimodal-minus-metrics differences for primary AP, control alert episodes per hour and localization MRR.

admissibility: Pass the mandatory control false-alert gate.
Primary average precision must exceed empirical prevalence; report the cluster-bootstrap confidence interval of the difference.
Localization MRR and Hit@3 must both exceed their random references as point estimates.
The direction of the response must be consistent across early, middle and late cells; no cell may be silently excluded.
No contract, integrity, leakage, duration, backlog, or control-plane safeguard may fail.
selection_order_among_admissible_candida: If absolute AP differs by at most 0.01, lowest control alert episodes per hour.
If still tied, highest localization MRR.
If still tied, prefer robust_rules, then isolation_forest, one_class_svm, hist_gradient_boosting, and lstm_temporal_autoencoder in that order as a deterministic simplicity tie-breaker.
Within a family, prefer metrics unless trimodal improves AP by more than 0.01 without worsening the control alert rate or localization MRR.
evaluation_plan.no_winner_policy: If no candidate is admissible, report that no algorithm was selected. Do not relax gates after reveal.

prohibited_actions: Inspecting sealed allocation, phase timelines, evaluation references, or labels before prediction commitment.
Using any blind run for fitting a model, scaler, score calibrator, threshold, hyperparameter, modality, or candidate subset.
Dropping a run, cell, service, feature, or candidate because of its blind performance.
Changing thresholds to control false alarms after seeing control labels.
Treating recovery as primary evidence or silently mixing it with normal/fault endpoints.
Selecting a different population for a candidate without reporting both common and native populations.
Revealing the allocation before all score files and model artifacts are hashed in blind_predictions_manifest_v1.
